title: Inconsistent data when using hundreds of mounts at the same time
body:
Recently I started experiment with SeaweedFS, one of our main use cases is to have hundreds of clients write to the same RWX Kubernetes volume, for this we are using the CSI driver.

My test consists of hundreds of pods between hundreds of nodes, each one doing 32MiB/s of file writes using fio all to the same directory.
All pods finish with success but when looking at the output data some files have a size of 0 bytes. Looking at the CSI driver I can see the following error message:

From my limited understanding looks like the volume is getting unmounted and unstaged before all the writes finish. If I had to create a theory behind it might be the fact the `weed mount` and consequently the CSI driver buffers data and doesn't finish the write before the volume gets unmounted (specially in high congestion scenarios).

Here is the fio test case:
```
[global]
ioengine=libaio
direct=1
thread=1
group_reporting=1
readwrite=write
percentile_list=50:95:99:99.9:99.99
filesize=128K
bs=128k
create_on_open=1
allow_file_create=1

directory=/swfs/target/distributed-write-128-32M-1
rate=1M,8M
numjobs=4
openfiles=16
nrfiles=4096

[write]
```

Here are the kubernetes yamls
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: swfs
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteMany
  capacity:
    storage: 10Ti
  csi:
    driver: seaweedfs-csi-driver
    volumeHandle: swfs
    volumeAttributes:
      collection: default
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  volumeMode: Filesystem
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: swfs
spec:
  storageClassName: ""
  volumeName: swfs
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteMany
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Ti
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  labels:
    app: swfs-bench
  name: swfs-bench
  namespace: default
spec:
  parallelism: 128
  suspend: false
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: swfs-bench
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchExpressions:
                - key: app
                  operator: In
                  values:
                  - swfs-bench
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            weight: 1
      containers:
      - command:
        - bash
        - -l
        - -c
        - |
          apt update && apt install -y fio
          RANDOM_FILENAME=$(head /dev/urandom | tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 | head -c 10)
          echo "Starting... - $RANDOM_FILENAME"
          date
          fio --filename_format=$RANDOM_FILENAME.\$filenum.\$jobnum --output-format=json --output=/swfs/target/out-128-32M-1/$RANDOM_FILENAME.json /swfs/distributed-write.fio
          echo "Finished... - $RANDOM_FILENAME"
          date
          sleep 5
        image: ubuntu:latest
        name: worker
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "4"
            memory: 8G
          requests:
            cpu: "2"
            memory: 2G
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /swfs
          name: swfs
      volumes:
      - name: swfs
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: swfs
```
